notes: Printed: 'Reach (This creature can block creatures with flying.) Deathtouch.' Serra Angel (4/4 flying) attacks; the defending Thornweald Archer may block it (block ask offers the Angel) and its 2 deathtouch damage destroys the 4/4; the Archer (2/1) dies to the 4 damage. A plain 2/2 without reach is never offered a block against the flyer.
